tip: liten is irregular: it becomes litet with an ett-word and små in the plural. Barnet är litet uses the ett-form.
Swedish has no separate continuous tense. skiner covers both 'shines' and 'is shining', so Solen skiner means the sun is shining now.
To say where you are from, use komma från: Vi kommer från Göteborg literally says 'we come from', but it means we are from.
The dummy subject stays det är no matter what follows: det är varmt. Learners wrongly reach for den är with en-words.
Many ett-words ending in a consonant look the same in the plural: ett ägg, tolv ägg. No ending is added.
For ta, the command form is Ta, the same as the infinitive, so an order is Ta buss nummer sju. The present tar is not used to give an order.
When a sentence starts with something other than the subject, the verb still comes second: Idag äter vi, never Idag vi äter.
barn is the same in singular and plural; the definite plural just adds -en, so Barnen means the children.
Weather statements need a filler subject det: Nu börjar det regna. Here det carries no real meaning of its own.

english: The children are woken at seven o'clock.
tip: Adding -s to the verb makes it passive: väcker (wakes) becomes väcks (is woken). Barnen väcks means the children get woken.
gott om is a fixed phrase meaning plenty of: ha gott om tid means to have plenty of time.
After an adjective like redo, link the following verb with att plus the infinitive: redo att gå (ready to go).
"Nyligen" = recently. Goes between "har" and the supine.
To prefer one thing to another, use föredra X framför Y. Here framför means 'over, rather than', not physically in front of.
"Igår" first → "regnade" second → "det" third. This is V2 inversion.
man is the generic 'you, one' for what people in general do: Här kan man köpa biljetter means here one can buy tickets.

english: The forest is beautiful in autumn.
tip: Seasons take på plus the definite form: på hösten (in autumn), på våren (in spring).

english: A country with a lot of forest.
tip: Use mycket with uncountable nouns like skog: mycket skog. For countable things you would switch to många instead.

english: Breakfast is included in the price.
tip: ingå i means to be included in: Frukosten ingår i priset says breakfast is part of the price.

english: There is bread on the shelf.
tip: Det finns means 'there is' for existence: det finns bröd på hyllan. Det är means 'it is', like det är bröd.

english: The meeting lasts for an hour.
tip: For how long something lasts, use i plus the time span: varar i en timme means lasts for an hour.

english: So far everything has gone well.
tip: The perfect uses har plus the supine: har allt gått bra. The supine gått is a distinct form from the plain past tense.

target: Därav följer att vi bör agera nu.
tip: bör means ought to or should, a bit stronger and more formal than kan: vi bör agera means we should act.

target: Hon är mycket omtyckt av alla sina kollegor.
english: She is very well liked by all her colleagues.
tip: In passive phrases, av marks who does it, like English 'by': omtyckt av kollegor means liked by colleagues.

target: Katten sover alltid i sin favoritstol framför brasan.
english: The cat always sleeps in its favorite chair by the fireplace.
tip: sin points back to the subject of the sentence: sin favoritstol means the cat's own chair, not someone else's.

target: God kväll, hoppas du har haft en bra dag.
english: Good evening, I hope you've had a good day.
tip: Bra never changes form: en bra dag, and it stays bra in every position, unlike stor which becomes stort.

target: Vi har en stuga i fjällen dit vi åker.
english: We have a cabin in the mountains where we go.
tip: dit means 'to where' and marks movement toward a place; där is for a fixed location. Åka takes dit.

target: Ett stort akvarium står i väntrummet hos vår tandläkare.
english: A large aquarium stands in the waiting room at our dentist.
tip: hos means 'at the place of' a person: hos vår tandläkare means at our dentist's.

target: En varm kopp kaffe gör underverk en kall vintermorgon.
english: A warm cup of coffee works wonders on a cold winter morning.
tip: No word for 'of' sits between a measure and its contents: en kopp kaffe means a cup of coffee, just placed side by side.

target: Akta dig, jag förstår hur du känner dig just nu!
english: Watch out, I understand how you feel right now!
tip: känna is reflexive when it means to feel: du känner dig means you feel. The dig is required, not optional.
